selection: All 18 strong-gap candidates in the frozen PR107 marginal diagnostic, including the 3 already excluded
count_selection: Exactly the inherited largest-Hellinger interval for each candidate; no new count or geometry search
threshold: Certify floor((mu-lambda)/log(mu/lambda)) uniformly over the rational mean intervals; if not unique use floor of the midpoint of the mean midpoints as a fixed event
normalization: Mode-centered Poisson weights, downward recurrence to zero, fixed upward recurrence and a geometric upper-tail remainder; directed integer rounding
decision: Event-probability difference lower > 1/4 excludes a candidate; otherwise retain HOLD. Single-count upper bounds are never full-joint-law upper bounds.
stop: One fixed analytical pass over the 18 inherited intervals. No larger budget, extra samples, geometry optimization or joint-law volume integration.
